WHAT: PostToolUse hook in ~/.claude/settings.json that fires after every Bash tool call containing 'git commit'. Sends a nudge to update memory about the project's journey.

WHERE: ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/claude-plugins-official/plugins/post-commit-memory/hooks/post-commit-hook.sh
Hook registered in ~/.claude/settings.json under PostToolUse

PURPOSE: Not a code log — a story prompt. The nudge says something like 'Think about what just happened in context of this project's journey — what's happening, where it's heading, what matters.' No commit message noise, just narrative documentation.

Ned's framing: 'optimize the prompt to say you should update your memory about what was achieved and stuff like that' — project story, not git history.

STATUS: Shipped and registered as of late March 29, 2026.
